checks.name: V1 [the family is a composition law, not a family of unrelated curves] the identity 1 - mu_n = (1 - mu_1)^n is verified symbolically for three members
checks.measured: 1 - mu_n = (1 - mu_1)^n holds exactly for n = 2, 3, 4
checks.reading: so n is a composition count: mu_n is 'at least one of n independent channels responds' with mu_1 the single-channel response. That is a real structure, and it is exactly why n is a COUNT rather than a dial -- but nothing in it fixes the count

checks.name: V2 [and the ALGEBRAICALLY distinguished member is n = 3, not n = 2] the free function is integrated in closed form for three members and each tested for a logarithm, since a rational member is the structurally clean one
checks.measured: logarithm present: {1: True, 2: True, 3: False}; the rational member is n = [3]
checks.reading: n = 3 is the only one of the three with a rational closed form; n = 2 shares its logarithm with n = 1. So on simplicity grounds the family singles out THREE, not two. That is evidence against reading the exponent off the mathematics

checks.name: V3 [the one n = 2-specific fact found, and it is weak] the integral of the residual 1 - mu_n over the whole range is tested for convergence at n = 2 and n = 3
checks.measured: integral of (1+sqrt z)^-n from 1 to infinity: n=2 gives oo, n=3 gives 3/4
checks.reading: the integral converges only above n = 2, so n = 2 is exactly the MARGINAL index -- the boundary case. That is the sort of thing a criticality argument could pick out, and L229 did find the cosmological state sitting at the function's critical point. But a boundary case is not a derivation, and this is recorded as suggestive at best

checks.name: V4 [four angles searched, none fixes the exponent] the structural angles examined are listed with their outcomes and those returning a clean negative counted
checks.measured: 4 angles searched; 3 return an explicit negative; none fixes n = 2
checks.reading: the closest thing to a derivation is the phase-space reading, and it wants three halves rather than two. Two of the four angles positively favour a DIFFERENT member

checks.name: V5 [so the honest scoreboard on the exponent] the evidence for and against the value the data select is set side by side and counted
checks.measured: FOR n = 2: the SPARC rotation curves prefer it with zero free parameters (L232), and it is the marginal index of the family (V3). AGAINST: the algebraically clean member is n = 3 (V2), degree-of-freedom counting wants 3/2, and duality singles out n = 1 (V4)
checks.reading: one empirical argument for, three structural arguments pointing elsewhere. The data select the exponent and the mathematics does not, which is the opposite of what a derivation looks like

checks.name: V6 [what this does NOT overturn] the status of L232's result after these negatives is stated, since a failed search for a reason does not touch a measurement
checks.measured: L232 stands unchanged: on 155 curves and 2788 points with nothing fitted, n = 2 gives 0.1502 dex against 0.1660 for n = 1 and 0.1853 for n = 3. The searches recorded here bear on WHY, not on WHETHER
checks.reading: the empirical result is untouched. What is now much less likely is that a short structural argument for the exponent is waiting to be found -- four were tried and the two that came closest point at other integers
